post.caption:
A puzzle ring falls apart when removed. It is several linked bands that fit together as one ring. Once it comes off the finger, the bands come apart. To solve one, bring the outside bands together first. Puzzle rings have been made for at least a few centuries. Nobody knows who invented the first one, or where. They likely grew out of the older gimmel ring. Gimmel comes from a Latin word for twin. In some, each partner wore one hoop until the wedding. Puzzle rings are still made and sold in Turkey today. Most puzzle rings have four or six bands.
